permissions.name: View my dashboard
permissions.description: Personal task summary, deadlines, performance and projects.

permissions.name: View team dashboard
permissions.description: Task statistics and team performance for the people the user manages.

permissions.name: View organization dashboard
permissions.description: Task, department, project and employee statistics for the whole organization.

permissions.name: View charts and reports
permissions.description: Open the charts and analytics: status, trend, deadlines, workload and progress.

permissions.name: Use dashboard filters
permissions.description: Filter dashboard analytics by department, project, employee and period.

permissions.name: View my tasks
permissions.description: See tasks the user created or is assigned to, on the list, board and details screens.

permissions.name: View all tasks
permissions.description: See every task in the organization. Without it a user sees only tasks they created or are assigned to.

permissions.name: Create tasks
permissions.description: Create tasks, or copy an existing one, and assign them.

permissions.name: Delete tasks
permissions.description: Delete a task from the list or the details screen.

permissions.name: Edit tasks
permissions.description: Change the title, description, priority, deadline, reminders and other details of a task.

permissions.name: Reassign tasks
permissions.description: Move a task to another assignee.

permissions.name: Manage task recipients
permissions.description: Choose who is notified about a task.

permissions.name: Post task comments
permissions.description: Write comments in a task's discussion.

permissions.name: View task history
permissions.description: Open a task's activity history.
